messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PDR-1247 fired — 'high-runtime-latency' on hosted-api-us-west. 95p latency > 2.0s for 2m. Affected: runtime-gateway-prod. Pager: @emma. https://pd.example/incidents/PDR-1247

emma: acked on PD, looking into it now. pinging runtime infra.

ben: seeing queue depth spike on gpu-runtime-2. no 5xxs in prod, just tail latency. opening APM traces: https://apm.example/trace/abc123

carla: can we divert traffic to dedicated pool (dedicated-gpu-1)? if we can shift some traffic it should reduce queuing.

diego: rerouting 10% to dedicated-gpu-1 now (route-control/canary). monitoring e2e latency.

ben: logs snippet from gateway showing tail latencies — 
```
[runtime-gateway-prod] 95p_latency_ms=2134
[runtime-gateway-prod] 95p_latency_ms=2240
[runtime-gateway-prod] 95p_latency_ms=1989
```

carla: good catch. looks like a short KV cache warmup + scheduler burst. not seeing underlying GPU OOMs or node failures.

pagerduty: Update: Incident PDR-1247 status changed to "triggered" -> awaiting acknowledgement.

emma: confirmed queues dropping as traffic shifts, 95p back down to ~380ms for the canary group. still watching global.

incident-bot: PagerDuty activity: PDR-1247 auto-resolved at 1833010108 — alert condition no longer present.

emma: I don't see any customer-facing errors in SLO dashboards. incident appears to be a transient spike, maybe caused by a late job on a multi-tenant host.

ben: agree — traces point to a background batch that overlapped with a traffic surge. no retries or errors surfaced to clients.

carla: recommend we tune the PD rule: require 3m sustained 95p > 2s AND affected_hosts >= 5 before paging. also add a suppression window for scheduled infra jobs. snippet: 
```yaml
- name: high-runtime-latency
  condition: 95p_latency > 2000ms
  duration: 3m
  min_hosts: 5
  notify: pagerduty
```

diego: +1. I'll file a follow-up infra ticket and add a temporary suppression for the batch job window.

emma: handing off warm monitoring to night oncall (@alex) in 30m. alex, note: auto-resolved, no customer impact, follow-ups: infra-ticket-4321 (scheduler), pd-rule-tune-987.

alex: noted. will keep an eye on the next hour and pick up the infra ticket tomorrow morning. if it pops again we'll escalate.

sre-rotation: Incident PDR-1247 marked auto-resolved. Action items: 1) infra-ticket-4321 (scheduling backoff) 2) PD rule change PR 3) add short-term suppression during batch windows. tagging @carla for follow-up. :white_check_mark:

carla: creating infra-ticket-4321 now and adding details. thanks folks.

ben: logging this as a low-severity flapping alert; no customer impact. recommend add to internal runbook: "transient runtime latency" with steps to route to dedicated pool, check queue depth, and adjust PD sensitivity.

emma: closing loop here. if anyone sees reoccurrence, open a new thread and tag oncall. :thumbsup:
